subject: general
question: Which of the following teams won the Tata Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Gujarat Titans (GT)'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gujrat Titans(GT) **won the Tata Indian Premier League **(IPL) 2022.** 
 
• GT won IPL 2022 **by 7 wickets **from Rajasthan Royals under the captaincy of **Hardik Pandya.**
 
• GT **played 14 matches **and **won 10** of them to become the leading team of the year. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• 2022 was the **debut year** of Gujrat Titans.
 
• IPL is a** mega cricket event** which is organized annually in India on a very large scale
